slug: 2026-02-16 Nigeria launches nationwide ward-level drive to boost digital ID coverage and inclusion

systems.owner: National Identity Management Commission (NIMC); programme funded by the World Bank, European Investment Bank and French Development Agency
systems.tiers: enrolment by NIMC in all wards of the 774 Local Government Areas from 2026-02-16; heads of local governments engaged beforehand

note: The enrolment drive is the national identity agency's own, carried out in wards; local governments are consulted and the document says nothing of their offices' connection.
